intro: What the model does not know of this world: a few sentences each, sent only to the steps they serve, and only when the scene holds what they are tagged with. Never shown to the player, never translated.
scenarioIntro: The scenario's own lore, added to the world's; a fragment sharing the reference of a world one replaces it.

kindHints.rule: Arbitration only: what is possible, what is forbidden, how the world reacts.
kindHints.ambiance: The narrator only: what is seen, heard and smelt.
kindHints.fact: Arbitration and the narrator: who holds sway, what happened, what people believe.

contentHint: A few sentences of English. A fragment the narrator reads names no unique person — say "the pastor", not his name — and nothing behind a passage.
tagsHint: The place the character stands in or any place around it, a person present, an item in sight or in hand. Nothing ticked: sent with every turn.
secret: Secret: arbitration weighs it, the narrator never reads it
secretAmbiance: An ambiance goes to the narrator only: it cannot be secret.
